description: This file defines a module for generating agent flow configurations, including schema definitions, utility functions to retrieve nodes and templates, and a main function to generate agent flow data based on user questions. It interacts with external components, files, and a queue system, and exports a generateAgentflowv2 function.

methods.name: getAllAgentFlow2Nodes
methods.description: Retrieves all nodes categorized as 'Agent Flows' from the running express app's node pool.

methods.name: getAllToolNodes
methods.description: Retrieves all tool nodes, excluding disabled and specific tool names, from the app's node pool.

methods.name: getAllAgentflowv2Marketplaces
methods.description: Reads marketplace JSON files, validates and formats them into templates, and returns a formatted string of examples.

methods.name: generateAgentflowv2
methods.description: Main function that generates agent flow configuration based on a user question, interacting with queue or direct API, and validating the response.
